errors.text: The required 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell boundary is replaced by an unsupported generic threshold of more than 1000 atoms and a percolating-cluster criterion.

The hypothesis conflates electronic DOS-gap contributions with the phase-space distribution learned by the MTP; electronic excitation free energies generally require explicit electronic-structure treatment rather than merely an MTP representation.
SRO-dependent dislocation barriers, DAPB energetics, and high-frequency VDOS changes are imported from unrelated alloys and properties without evidence that they control TaVCrW melting free energies.
